**Faculty of Shari'a**  
**Master in Hadith**

**0431731 Hadith Sciences (3 credit Hours)**  
This course discusses deeply the most important Hadith issues such as the analytical study for the basis of this science, highlighting and discussing the scholars’ special terms both in terms of subject classification and authenticity classification. This is done through academic critique towards text and chain of narrators of Hadith.

**0441732 Methodologies of Scholars of Hadith (3 credit Hours)**  
This course discusses the methodologies which have been adapted by Hadith scholars when they classified the Hadith narrations in addition to historical development in writing in this science. It highlights the efforts of these scholars in collecting and preserving these narrations from being lost. It demonstrates as well, the hot issues in which researchers of this field have to tackle in this modern time.

**0451733 Hadith Narrators (3 credit Hours)**  
This course tackles the manners followed by Hadith scholars in classifying Hadith narrators, in terms of their names, descent ship, nicknames, date of birth, names of teachers and students, scientific journeys, viewpoints of scholars towards them. It tackles as well, how scholars manage to adapt a standpoint towards these narrators in terms of acceptance and refusal.

**0441734 Rules of the Judgment on Hadith (3 credit Hours)**  
This course shows the rules in which scholars have invented to study and critique narrations of Hadith, through highlighting the basis and restrictions upon which scholars distinguish between authentic and false Hadiths. It tackles as well how to guide and direct the student to the right application for these rules and restrictions when dealing with the Hadith narrations.

**0441735 Rules of Research and editing (3 credit Hours)**  
This course highlights the fundamental rules of academic research methods. The preconditions in which researchers must fulfill, the characteristics of good academic research. It covers as well the rules of manuscripts’ editing in terms of publishing them in an acceptable form and in terms of the rules of how to confirm the attribution of a certain book to its author.

**0431736 Analytic Hadith (3 credit Hours)**  
An analytic study will be paid to the expressions and explanations of certain Hadiths selected from famous Hadith books. The study will also cover what can be resulted from these Hadiths as rules and faith matters.
